steps.text: A Chassis does nothing on its own: a machine is the modules on its six faces.
A Fuel Engine burns fuel from the Purple storage into RF for the whole machine. Any face will do.
A Heater smelts with that RF: it takes ore from the Orange storage and puts ingots in Green.
An Inventory Access Panel lets you reach the storages: right-click it with an empty hand.
Lit faceplates show which modules are working. No settings needed.
